title: PAIOS Policy Bundle
description: An immutable, versioned set of governance rules evaluated by the Policy Decision Point. A request pins a bundle version at context resolution and evaluates against that version for its entire lifetime.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, used by editors for completion and inline validation.

bundle_version.description: Semantic version. Immutable once published; a governance change produces a new version rather than editing an existing one.

supersedes.description: Version of the bundle this one replaces. Absent on the first published bundle.

confidence_threshold.description: Model-assisted results below this confidence are classified as 'unclassified', which the risk engine treats as sensitive.

deterministic_rules.description: Authoritative pattern rules. A request matched here is not revisited by the model-assisted pass.

decision_rules.description: Evaluated as an unordered set. All matching rules are collected, then resolved by: deny overrides; otherwise require_approval; otherwise allow; otherwise require_approval when nothing matched.

timeout_minutes.description: Elapsed time before an unanswered approval escalates. Timeout never resolves to approved or denied.

agent_policies.description: Agent policies governed by this bundle. See agent-policy.schema.json.

rule_id.description: Stable identifier. Recorded on the decision so that reasoning is recoverable from the immutable bundle.

agent_role.description: Logical agent role. Resolution to a concrete model happens at execution time and is recorded in the audit trail.

match.description: All present conditions must hold for the rule to match. An omitted condition is unconstrained.

obligations.description: Merged across all matched rules: permissions intersect, restrictions union. A rule can only narrow what another rule permits.

approver_role.description: Required when the resolved effect is require_approval. The most restrictive role among matched rules is used.

restricted_actions.description: Unioned across matched rules. Enforced by the persona binder as execution-time restrictions, not prompt instructions.

output_target.description: Destination for approved output. The knowledge writer may not write elsewhere.

audit_required.description: Auditing is unconditional in this design; the field exists to make the requirement explicit in policy, not to disable it.
